adopt.title: Viewing-proposal policy + objection playbooks — define WHEN Amanda offers the viewing and what she does with 'too expensive / wrong area / just looking'
adopt.merged_from: conversion-maximizer #1 + the playbook half of conversion-maximizer #8
adopt.reason: The doc specifies every safety rail around book_viewing and never the trigger for proposing one — as written, Amanda waits to be asked, which is the biggest funnel leak in the whole design. A deterministic readiness scorer (same pattern as the §10 disengagement machine) + two-concrete-slots phrasing + once-per-property blocker costs 3-4 days and is measurable in P1 shadow as proposal precision, giving the promotion gate a conversion metric next to the safety ones. The three objection playbooks are prompt doctrine + golden scenarios on tools that already exist (search_properties, get_area_info, ask_agency) — they turn the most common conversation-enders into next steps at near-zero infra cost. Both obey §10's one-question law by construction.
adopt.phase_fit: P1 (scorer + doctrine + golden scenarios, measured in shadow); live behavior lands automatically with P2 auto-replies. ~4-5 days.

adopt.title: Day-one data pack: funnel events + turn behavior tags/version stamps + resolution-rate metric + draft-edit diffs + ticket question_category + rejection reasons
adopt.merged_from: conversion-maximizer #6, learning-flywheel #2, learning-flywheel #3 (logging half only), learning-flywheel #4 (tagging half only), learning-flywheel #5 (capture half only), competitor-sota #5 (metric half only)
adopt.reason: The purest LOG-NOW-BUILD-THE-LOOP-LATER cluster: ~3-4 days total, none of it new intelligence, all of it unrecoverable if skipped. Funnel events (lead→engaged→proposed→booked→attended→offer, amanda_attributed) are the renewal pitch and pilot go/no-go evidence — 'Amanda booked 12 viewings this month' cannot be reconstructed later. Resolution rate is a 1-day query over telemetry the doc already collects and becomes the §6 'one trust number' with real ground truth. Draft-edit diffs are time-critical: the approval phase is a shrinking window — once an agency reaches full-auto that supervision stream ends forever. Ticket question_category and rejection reasons must exist before tickets and rejections accumulate. All analysis, distillation, and report UIs stay post-launch per the endorsed cuts — only the logging ships now.
adopt.phase_fit: P0: funnel_events schema next to turn_usage. P1: turn_events emission + version stamps + edit-diff storage + rejection-reason extraction in the lead-state build + resolution-rate definition. P1/P2: question_category at ticket creation. Loops post-launch.

adopt.title: Lean descope pack with a written build-when trigger ledger: Ping Spine v0, Media Law v0 (STT→P2 gate), golden suite 25-30 core + grow-from-reality
adopt.merged_from: lean-cutter #2, #3, #4, #5 + learning-flywheel #6 (one-tap add-failure-to-suite is the growth mechanism); dormant-return re-confirmation from cold-completeness #9 added as a ledger line
adopt.reason: Not an addition but the subtraction that funds the additions — roughly 10 build days deferred behind objective triggers, without losing a word of the design. Ping Spine v0 keeps everything that is law (dedicated Office sender, no-auto-relay-on-ambiguity, matching ladder, back-translation echo, quiet hours) and defers the cadence engine polish until live ticket evidence shapes it. Media Law v0 ('never auto-act on unparsed media, ask to type it') covers the red-team's actual fear in an hour and — the underrated win — keeps the STT vendor OUT of Christian's DPA annex until P2, shortening his blocking legal work. The 25-30-scenario core suite still covers every safety invariant at P1; the 48h failure-to-scenario conversion rule means by P2 the suite is 60+ and shaped by reality instead of imagination. The ledger itself is the founder's defense against document-order-as-build-order.
adopt.phase_fit: Doc change now (~0.5 day); Media Law rule in P0; Ping Spine v0 in P2; suite growth continuous; each deferred subsystem lands when its written trigger fires.

adopt.title: Payments/IBAN platform floor — Amanda never transmits bank details, plus the fraud-caution line
adopt.reason: Hours of effort against an existential failure mode: WhatsApp deposit fraud with spoofed agents is endemic in Spanish coastal real estate, and neither the §2 no-commitment floor nor the §3c sensitive list covers 'where do I send the deposit?'. A deterministic outbound IBAN/account-number block (regexes cleanly across all 13 languages, unlike tone) + escalation to a named human + one golden probe. One incident where 'Amanda' appears to send payment instructions ends the product.
adopt.phase_fit: P1 — it is a floor rule, costs hours, exists from the first real message.

adopt.title: GDPR rights as a chat intent + retention schedule + one-paragraph DR statement
adopt.reason: A genuine hole in an otherwise compliance-heavy design: §5 promises rights via URL, but 'delete my data' typed into WhatsApp starts a statutory 1-month clock whether or not anything catches it — missing it is a real breach and exactly the failure that kills agency trust. Classifier intents {erasure, access, objection} + a deadline-clocked rights ticket type ride the existing ticket machinery. The retention schedule and a verified-PITR restore drill are the missing operational half of the 'must not fail' doctrine — losing conversation state means losing pending viewings. Policy text rides the DPA work Christian already owns, so no new external dependency.
adopt.phase_fit: P1: rights intents + golden probes + DR statement/restore drill. P2 gate: retention schedule + automated deletion job. ~2-3 days + Christian sign-off he is already doing.

adopt.title: Property-alert opt-in captured in conversation — the only long-horizon nurture channel the design's own rules permit
adopt.merged_from: competitor-sota #3 + the opt-in half of conversion-maximizer #8
adopt.reason: The doc's anti-pushiness law (2 nudges then dormant-forever) is right, but AIVENA's buyers run 6-18 month cycles — and the design's own compliant answer, the consented ≤1/week alert stream (§10), has no capture mechanism: nowhere does Amanda ever ASK. Without this, every cooled lead is permanently forfeited, in precisely the slow-cycle market. One earned ask per lead at three deterministic moments, button tap = consent_marketing per the §5 split, dormancy stops conversation but never the subscription, any reply reactivates the engine. Strategic side effect: it correctly re-prices Christian-owned item #3 from 'blocks property-push only' to 'blocks long-cycle nurture revenue' and forces it onto the critical path.
adopt.phase_fit: P2: opt-in ask + consent recording (gated on Christian item #3). P2/P3: alert scheduler on the existing matching engine. ~4-5 days total.

adopt.title: Conversation entry kit: missed-call text-back wiring, per-property wa.me links + QR, web-to-WhatsApp invite, first-touch template for non-WhatsApp leads
adopt.reason: The plan engineers the middle of the funnel and contains zero words on how a conversation STARTS; viewings scale linearly with conversation starts. Half the pieces already exist (missed-call text-back is BUILT-NOT-WIRED per the 2026-08-24 truth table; the §4 verified-phone identity link covers web handoff). A wa.me link with the property ref prefilled makes Amanda's turn 1 property-grounded — her strongest first impression — and the sub-5-minute first-touch effect is the most replicated stat in the industry. Guardrails all exist: utility-class template, consent logged at source, one nudge max then stop, executor gate unchanged. All entry sources tagged for the funnel-events attribution.
adopt.phase_fit: P2 (needs live auto-replies so starts get answered); the first-touch/missed-call template joins the Meta 13-language pipeline NOW. ~4-5 days.

adopt.title: Hot-lead 'call now' alert — Amanda detects, the human closes
adopt.reason: The design pings agents about QUESTIONS but never about BUYERS. A lead with budget + timeline + offer language is worth a phone call within minutes, and the entire delivery mechanism already exists (ping spine, P1-HOT tier, the [I've got it] claim button explicitly designed for agents who call instead of typing). One deterministic trigger, max 1 per lead per 72h, never blocks Amanda's own reply. Two days for the single highest-leverage human-in-the-loop moment in the funnel.
adopt.phase_fit: P2, the moment the ping spine exists. ~2 days.

adopt.title: Offline-contact awareness — auto-hold on agent activity + a 10-second 'log contact' quick action
adopt.reason: The most LIKELY daily 'Amanda looks stupid' incident in the design: agents phone buyers constantly, calls leave no trace, and full-auto Amanda then contradicts what was just agreed by voice. The ping spine's claim button only covers ticket-triggered calls; §6 hand-back only covers claimed handoffs. Auto-hold on any agent activity for that lead + a NOTE quick action parsed as ground truth (same ingestion class as the existing hand-back note — no new trust machinery). Two days to protect the trust the whole product depends on.

adopt.title: Non-buyer intent lanes — vendor/seller capture + rental routing
adopt.reason: The buyer-facing number WILL receive 'I want to sell my villa', and a vendor lead is the most valuable inbound a small agency gets (listings are their lifeblood) — today Amanda would treat the vendor as a confused buyer. Three intake questions + a vendor_lead ticket + escalation push, with the valuation launch gate standing order absolutely intact (Amanda never estimates value). Rental/spam lanes keep the funnel clean. ~2 days for a decisive agency-trust and revenue feature.
adopt.phase_fit: P1: classifier lanes calibrated in shadow. P2: vendor-ticket surface + push. ~2 days.

adopt.title: Trip-mode Phase A: trip_dates as a first-class lead-state slot
adopt.reason: This is how Costa Blanca internationals actually buy — a 3-5 day fly-in trip, then decide — and the departure flight is honest urgency that passes §10's banned-pattern screen because it is fact, not fake scarcity. Phase A is just one intel slot in the §1 lead-state (asked once via the existing slow-drip discipline) that makes the viewing-proposal policy and re-engagement whitelist trip-aware. 1-2 days for the single most demographic-fitting piece of intelligence in the system. Phase B (multi-viewing itinerary) stays post-launch — see rejects.

adopt.title: Outbound property cards — deterministic renderer, model chooses when, code decides what
adopt.reason: For holiday-home buyers the photo IS the product; a text-only villa description loses to any rival agent who sends five photos, and in-session media costs nothing extra. The design keeps grounding intact by construction: deterministic renderer pulls hero image + as-listed price + facts from the catalogue row; cards count against rejected_property_ids. Honest constraint adopted with it: the catalogue image layer is ~60% hotlinked (Packet-3 audit), so cards ship for owned/mirrored-image properties only, and the image-mirroring backfill graduates from parked to a real P2 prerequisite for full coverage.
adopt.phase_fit: P2 (~2 days for the tool; mirroring backfill scheduled separately as its prerequisite).

adopt.title: WABA number health telemetry + automatic conservative mode
adopt.reason: Meta quality-rating drops silently throttle or kill the buyer-facing number — an existential dependency the doc only touches at template level. Buyer blocks are also the truest 'Amanda is annoying' signal and belong next to the dial-promotion evidence. Poll quality rating + tier, alert Christian on any drop, auto-drop to conservative mode (proactive sends off). 1-2 days to instrument the asset the entire business runs on.
adopt.phase_fit: P2, the moment Amanda auto-sends at volume. 1-2 days.

adopt.title: Two runbooks: incident one-pager (P1) + agency-offboarding wind-down (P2 gate)
adopt.reason: The invariant monitor alerts Christian — a solo non-coder — with no written procedure; at this company's size the runbook IS the on-call system, and it must exist before real traffic. Offboarding is an Art. 28 return-or-delete obligation the DPA will promise with no machinery behind it, plus live buyers mid-thread; needed before a second real agency. Mostly writing, 1-2 days total.
adopt.phase_fit: Incident one-pager: P1. Offboarding state machine: P2 gate.

reject.reason: Nothing to build now — its inputs are exactly the adopted day-one data pack, and it needs multiple agencies of real volume to mean anything; pure post-launch analysis.

reject.reason: Right metrics, wrong moment — with zero real traffic any published number is fiction; compute them from P1 shadow onward (adopted) and let marketing use them when they are real.

Ban human-mimicry tricks (intentional typos, fake typing, any human pretense) in the §5 classification memo — Amanda's jittered pacing is the honest half; the dishonest half violates Art. 50 spirit and Meta's 2026 AI policy
AI voice calling stays out of this packet — separate lane, multiplies every risk the 79 findings just fenced (grounding, disclosure, Spanish recording-consent law)

judge.overall: Honest answer: the half of the plan that exists is near-optimal — the conversation engine, safety chassis, and compliance spine survived two adversarial reviews and none of the five lenses found anything wrong INSIDE it. What they found, with striking independence, is that the plan engineers the middle of the funnel and goes silent at both ends. Nothing defines when Amanda proposes a viewing (she waits to be asked). Nothing happens after a viewing is booked — no reminder, no outcome, no follow-up — so the money metric leaks 25-40% to no-shows the design never sees. Nothing wires how conversations start for leads that don't arrive via WhatsApp. And the data that would prove any of it works (funnel events, outcomes, behavior tags, edit diffs) isn't being logged, which is the one omission that can never be backfilled. The adopted list fixes exactly those edges, and almost all of it rides machinery the doc already designed — roughly 3-4 weeks of work spread across P0-P3, of which only ~4-5 days touch P0/P1, largely offset by the ~10 days the endorsed lean descopes give back. The single thing that matters most now is not another addition — the marginal return on more planning just went negative. It is to start building the lean path this week: P0 core, then the P0.5 test-agency FULL loop, so the must-not-fail booking machinery gets months of live burn-in before any real buyer touches it (instead of its current maiden voyage at P3, on a pilot agency), Christian gets his demo and his conviction in weeks, and the DPA chain comes off the critical path of all visible progress. In the same week, submit the viewing-lifecycle and first-touch templates to Meta — approval latency is on Meta's clock, by the doc's own rule. Everything else layers in behind those two moves.
